generation.format: raw only; no chat or system wrapper; Gemma native BOS retained

combined.protocol: One row per retained first-stage parent. Joint judgment replaces first-stage judgment at a retained eligible extension. Ineligible parents keep first-stage judgment. Eligible excluded follow-ups remain unresolved. Never add or average the two panels.
combined.limits: Up to 512 initial tokens plus up to 512 at an eligible native turn boundary; unequal observed lengths. Existing window-level judge reversals and disagreements remain visible; no monotonic correction. Pooled over 16 families, two wordings, target/control.
